## About This Site

This is a technical portfolio site by viral32111, covering:

* Server infrastructure and administration
* Network management
* Software development
* Security and cryptography
* Hardware and embedded systems

All guides are provided for educational purposes. Users should verify commands and configurations for their specific use cases before applying to production systems.
